title: Demonic Path Movements
next_chapter_hook: Urgent message from the ally: There are doubts about the identity of the Demonic Path Supreme Commander. The mastermind behind the humiliation of the broken engagement back then was very likely this person.

text.content: The secret letter turned to ashes beneath the candlelight, yet Chen Ji's fingertips remained suspended in mid-air, motionless for a long while. Those words seared into his pupils like a branding iron—Chen Nian's imprisonment in the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds was merely bait. His breathing stayed steady as always, but within the depths of his eyes churned an overwhelming fury. This rage differed from any before; at this moment, he seemed to watch a play that had already ended, yet discovered the actors still performing with smug cleverness on stage.

Mo Xiansheng's withered remnant spirit drifted from the first page of the Tianji Record, its hollow eye sockets gazing at Chen Ji as if examining his emotional fluctuations. "Anger?" The remnant spirit's voice rasped like dry leaves scraping together. "Is this beneficial or detrimental to you?" Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes as the Tianji Record Fragment unfolded in his mind. The page concerning the Demonic Path Supreme Commander—its fate lines originally blurred—now faintly revealed intricate patterns intertwined with his own.

dialogue.content: "My master once said that those chosen by the Tianji Record as prophets never exist alone." Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit spoke slowly. "Every prophet's fate has a corresponding 'mirror image.' Your mirror... is that Demonic Path Supreme Commander."

text.content: Twin souls of destiny. Chen Ji opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the flickering candlelight. He recalled the vision he had glimpsed in the Tianji Record that day—when the Demonic Path Supreme Commander turned against his own side, that blurred face bore a startling resemblance to his own in certain angles. Mirror image, moonlit reflection—one laying schemes in the light, one manipulating pieces in the dark. He should have realized earlier that any existence capable of causing the Tianji Record to react so strongly could never be an ordinary opponent.

"Interesting." Chen Ji let out a low, chilling laugh that sent a cold shiver through the air. He stood up, walked to the window, and gazed toward the Imperial City swallowed by the night sky. The Demonic forces were gathering, and their contacts were those powers that had lost influence after his "death." Those turncoats, believing Chen Ji truly dead, rushed to grovel before their new masters. How ironic, how utterly... infuriating.

dialogue.content: "They think I'm dead." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "So they dared to harm my people, dared to set this trap. Very well, excellent." His fingers tapped lightly on the window lattice, each beat like striking the pulse of destiny itself. "Since they want to watch a play, I'll perform for them—a spectacular show they'll never forget till their dying breath."

choice.prompt: The Demonic forces are exploiting your "death" to orchestrate a grander conspiracy. You must make a decision:

choices.description: Since they believe you're dead, let them witness the fury of the "deceased" resurrected. Strike first to disrupt the Demonic Path's strategic rhythm.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing your whereabouts may provoke a full-scale counterattack from the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Disrupt enemy deployment and intimidate the turncoat forces
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Supreme Commander may detect that you are still alive

text.content: Chen Ji sneered coldly, his fingers tracing a rune pattern in the Void. He would make those people understand the price of using Chen Nian as bait—even if the news itself was false, anyone who dared conceive such a scheme must pay the price.

choices.description: Let them continue their performance. When they believe everything is under control, deliver the fatal strike. Sometimes, anger needs to be buried deeper.
choices.visible_cost: The Demonic Path forces may exploit this opportunity to expand their influence
choices.visible_reward: Reveal more enemies' cards and find the opportunity for a decisive strike
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Supreme Commander's scheme may become increasingly perfected

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze and sat back at his desk. His eyes had returned to that stillness of stagnant water, but those who knew him well understood what kind of storm was brewing beneath that calm. "Since they want to play," he murmured, "then let's play with them."

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly violently trembled. Chen Ji's brow center tightened—he sensed the gaze of destiny. It was a注视 transcending space, like the heavens opening a vertical eye to examine every piece on this chessboard. The Eye of Heavenly Dao. Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit had said the Tianji Record was merely one of the pieces the Heavenly Dao had placed in the mortal world, and Chen Ji, from the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, had already entered the game.

But entering the game does not mean accepting defeat. Chen Ji coldly smiled. He slowly pressed his hand onto the Tianji Record, allowing that窥视 force to sweep across his soul. He could feel the scrutiny and amusement within that gaze, as if observing an ant struggling on the chessboard. "Want to watch a show?" he whispered in his heart. "Then watch." He deliberately left a flaw in the Tianji Record—for the Eye of Heavenly Dao to see, and for the Demonic Path Supreme Commander to see.

A flaw is always a double-edged sword. Used well, it can lure the snake from its lair; used poorly, it invites death. But Chen Ji was never someone who would place himself in a deadly situation. He was gambling—gambling on the Heavenly Dao Eye's arrogance, on the Demonic Path Supreme Commander's greed, and on the ethereal bond between twin souls of destiny. He intended to use the Heavenly Dao's chess game against them, turning the tables in one masterful move.

dialogue.content: The instant Chen Ji released that flaw, a tremor resonated through the cosmos—not a sound, but a will directly poured into his divine soul. "Interesting." The will was ice-cold and vast, as if eons of years had condensed into cold indifference. "The new wielder of the Heavenly Secrets Record dares to provoke me proactively?"

text.content: Chen Ji's Mental Sea churned with turbulent waves, yet his expression remained unmoved, even curving into a hint of mockery. How many Seers throughout history had dared to speak directly with the Eye of Heavenly Way? Most of those chosen by the Tianji Record walked on eggshells, terrified of provoking this transcendent existence. But Chen Ji refused to comply. He was gambling— wagering that this Heavenly Way Will was not as omnipotent as it appeared.

choice.prompt: The Will of the Eye of Heavenly Way descends upon your Mental Sea—this is a crisis, but also an opportunity:

choices.description: Respond to this Heavenly Way Will with equal arrogance—since it wants to watch a show, give it a performance it has never witnessed. A Seer should not merely be a chess piece.
choices.visible_cost: May completely enrage the Heavenly Way Will, suffering Divine Retribution
choices.visible_reward: Establish a unique mark before the Ancestor of Dao, making it regard you with new eyes
choices.risk_hint: The response from the Eye of Heavenly Way may exceed your expectations
choices.process_label: 傲慢对峙，独一无二的预言者

text.content: Chen Ji's voice rang out in the Mental Sea, calm yet carrying undisguised mockery: "Provoke? Senior overestimates yourself. This junior merely wishes to ask—when does Senior intend to end this chess game?"

choices.description: Conceal your aura, pretending ignorance. Preserve your strength, avoid pointless trials—true trump cards should never be revealed to enemies.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to establish a connection with the Heavenly Way Will
choices.visible_reward: Retain more trump cards, preventing enemies from seeing through your depths
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Way Will may thus look down upon you

text.content: Chen Ji收敛心神，将自己的存在感压到最低。他能感觉到那道窥视在他身上停留了片刻，最终带着一丝失望——或者说是轻蔑——缓缓退去。但陈机知道，这种轻蔑，恰恰是他需要的。
识海中重归寂静，但陈机知道，暴风雨才刚刚开始。他在天机录中留下的破绽已经开始发酵——魔道那边会有反应，天道之眼也会继续观察。而他，需要在这一切发生之前，做好万全的准备。墨先生的残魂重新隐入天机录深处，临去前留下一句意味深长的话："命运双生子，一荣俱荣，一损俱损……但也可能是，一死一生。"
窗外忽然传来一声低沉的号角——那是魔道军营的集结号。陈机目光一凝，走到窗前，只见皇城西边的天际线上，隐约可见数十道灵光正在汇聚。那些灵光组成了一个巨大的阵纹，缓缓向皇城中心蔓延。魔道大军，开始动了。他布下的诱饵——那个关于陈念的假消息——正在发挥作用。敌人以为他在暗处，殊不知，他早已站在更高处俯瞰全局。

dialogue.content: "很好。"陈机转身，从暗格中取出一枚传讯玉符，"既然你们想借我'死'后的乱局做文章，那我便让你们见识一下，什么叫死人复生的恐怖。"他的手指在玉符上勾勒出复杂的符文，那是只有他能看懂的密语。"传我命令——所有暗子，按原计划行动。让他们知道，这天青宗的废墟之下，埋着的是一颗随时会炸裂的雷。"

text.content: 玉符化作流光消失在夜色中，陈机重新坐回案前。他的手指轻轻敲击着桌面，节奏沉稳而冷静。魔道主帅，那个与他命运纠缠的存在，即将浮出水面。而陈机已经迫不及待想要见一见这位"双生子"了。他想知道，当命运的两端相遇，会擦出怎样的火花。是同归于尽，还是……并肩而战？这个答案，或许很快就会揭晓。
就在这时，一道熟悉的气息从窗外掠过。陈机眉心一动——是相助者的灵鸽。他抬手接住那只通体漆黑的灵鸽，从它腿上解下一枚细小的玉简。玉简上的字迹让他瞳孔骤缩。"魔道主帅身份存疑，当年退婚之辱的幕后主使，很可能便是此人。"陈机握着玉简的手指微微发白，那是他刻意尘封的记忆——那段他从未向任何人提起的屈辱往事。
他闭上眼，那段记忆如潮水般涌来。七年前的冬天，他还未入天青宗，只是一个偏远山村的少年。那日，他与一位世家小姐订下婚约，以为那是此生最大的幸事。却不料，婚约签订后不到三月，那位小姐便当着全村人的面，将一纸退婚书扔在他脸上。"废物也配？"那四个字如同烙铁，灼了他整整七年。他以为那是那世家小姐的主意，以为那只是一个嫌贫爱富的俗套故事。但如今——
陈机睁开眼，眸中已是一片赤红。退婚之辱的幕后主使，竟是魔道主帅？那个与他命运纠缠的"双生子"？他忽然明白了为何当初那位世家小姐会那般决绝——不是她嫌贫爱富，而是有人逼她那么做。有人要彻底击碎一个少年的自尊，让他万劫不复。而那个人，很可能就是他命运中注定的对手。愤怒如同野火，在陈机胸腔中疯狂燃烧。
"好。"陈机的声音低得像是从牙缝里挤出来，带着压抑到极致的怒火，"很好。"他站起身，周身的灵力不受控制地涌动，在房间内掀起一阵狂风。命运双生子？一荣俱荣，一损俱损？既然如此，那就让这场宿命的对决，提前到来吧。他要让那个人知道，当年他施加在这个少年身上的一切屈辱，今日，他要十倍百倍地还回去。

choice.prompt: 得知退婚之辱的真相后，你的愤怒几乎要冲破理智的堤坝。但现在不是冲动的时候——你需要冷静下来，选择接下来的行动：

choices.description: Anger is anger, but Chen Ji would never let emotions dictate his judgment. He would mobilize all resources to investigate the Demonic Path Commander's true identity and past, seeking out his weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: Needs time to set up, may miss the opportunity for a preemptive strike
choices.visible_reward: Master all enemy intelligence, find the key to a one-strike kill
choices.risk_hint: Demonic Path commander-in-chief may also be investigating you

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. His fingers tapped lightly on the desk, quickly regaining that calculating calmness. "Investigate." He commanded to the empty air, "Use all hidden agents, I want to know everything about this person—origin, background, techniques, weaknesses, even what he likes to eat and which direction he sleeps towards, investigate thoroughly."

choices.description: Holy Maiden Ye Qing is his informant within the Demonic Path, and also the only person who might know the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's true details. He needs to obtain firsthand intelligence from her.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the alliance with Ye Qing may alert the Demonic Path commander-in-chief
choices.visible_reward: Obtain core intelligence from within the Demonic Path, and possibly receive Ye Qing's covert assistance
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's identity within the Demonic Holy Sect may also be suspected

text.content: Chen Ji took out a special communication jade talisman, the exclusive contact method with Ye Qing. The jade talisman glowed faintly, and his divine consciousness transformed into a thought and transmitted over: "Urgent matter to discuss, regarding the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's identity—how much do you know?" After a moment, Ye Qing's cold voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying a rare gravity: "You finally asked the right question."

As night deepened, the Spiritual Light formation patterns above the Imperial City grew increasingly dense. Signs of the Demonic Path army pressing at the borders had spread throughout the entire Imperial City, countless factions were on edge. Amidst these undercurrents, Chen Ji sat quietly by the window, gazing at the sky tinged red by the Spiritual Light. His eyes reflected the distant glow,
